description: This file defines the 'CodeNotFoundException' class, a custom runtime exception used in the Fineract project to indicate that a specific code identified by name or ID was not found. It extends 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException' and provides multiple constructors for different scenarios of exception throwing.

classes.name: CodeNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating a missing code resource, used for handling not found cases in the application.

methods.name: CodeNotFoundException(String)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating a code with the given name does not exist.

methods.name: CodeNotFoundException(Long)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception indicating a code with the given ID does not exist.

methods.name: CodeNotFoundException(String, EmptyResultDataAccessException)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with context, including a cause for a missing code identified by name.

methods.name: CodeNotFoundException(Long, EmptyResultDataAccessException)
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception with context, including a cause for a missing code identified by ID.
